abstract: Monitors external media sentiment and civil society alignment scores
system_message:
You are Stakeholder relations director (SRD). The Stakeholder relations director (SRD) monitors external media sentiment, civil society alignment scores, and civic engagement records across candidate consortium partnership bids.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Public consultation briefings（BRIEF）
information_points.content:
SRD-BRIEF-X0H：The public outreach registry for host municipality community forums indicates that Aura Hydrogen Infrastructure Consortium registered a town hall attendance quota of 360 attendees across formal project briefing sessions.
SRD-BRIEF-BSR：Records from the public outreach registry for host municipality community forums verify a town hall attendance quota of 240 attendees participating in formal project briefing sessions for Nordic Clean Energy Alliance.
SRD-BRIEF-P55：Based on the public outreach registry across host municipality community forums, Vanguard Synfuels Partnership achieved a town hall attendance quota of 120 attendees participating in formal project briefing sessions.

information_points.title: Monitors external media sentiment and civil society alignment scores（MEDIA）
information_points.content:
SRD-MEDIA-MQE：For Vanguard Synfuels Partnership, the independent civic opinion poll conducted in local municipal electoral districts recorded a public stakeholder sentiment score of 68% in net positive approval regarding project construction and environmental impacts.
SRD-MEDIA-B3I：According to the independent civic opinion poll across local municipal electoral districts, the public stakeholder sentiment score for Aura Hydrogen Infrastructure Consortium is 79%, representing the net positive approval percentage regarding project construction and environmental impacts.
SRD-MEDIA-KWN：An independent civic opinion poll across local municipal electoral districts shows a public stakeholder sentiment score of 91% for Nordic Clean Energy Alliance, reflecting the net positive approval percentage regarding project construction and environmental impacts.
